description: This file defines the ZendeskHelpProcessor class, which implements help-related functionalities for Zendesk integration within the OrangeHRM system, including URL construction, querying, and redirect handling.

classes.name: ZendeskHelpProcessor
classes.description: A class that handles help content retrieval and URL management for Zendesk within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getHelpConfigService
methods.description: Returns the HelpConfigService instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getHttpClient
methods.description: Returns the HTTP client instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getBaseUrl
methods.description: Retrieves the base help URL from the configuration service.

methods.name: getSearchUrl
methods.description: Constructs the search URL for a given label.

methods.name: getRedirectUrl
methods.description: Gets the redirect URL based on search results for a label.

methods.name: sendQuery
methods.description: Sends an HTTP GET request to the specified URL with headers, returns response data or null on failure.
